steps.label: Distroless (gcr.io/distroless)
steps.sub: no shell, no package manager — just the runtime

code:
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
COPY --from=build /app/server /server
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]

# docker exec -it <container> /bin/sh
# -> fails: there is no /bin/sh in this image
caption: If there's no shell, a whole category of post-exploitation tooling has nothing to run.

code:
FROM golang:1.22 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o server ./cmd/server

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12
COPY --from=build /src/server /server
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
caption: Only the compiled binary survives into the final image — the compiler never ships.
